title: AI37 A2A showcase extension v1
description: User-facing description of an agent for the product catalog (agents page and empty chat screen), embedded in Agent Card capabilities.extensions. The $id is an identifier, not a network endpoint. Text is the agent's own: norms must be verifiable, an empty list means the surface writes «Норматив уточняется». Normalisation clamps over-long strings and drops malformed items instead of rejecting the card — only a missing title or summary makes the profile unusable.

capabilities.description: Modes of the agent drawn as separate showcase tiles. A caption, not a skill: no billing gate, no routing; availability, norms and the future user switch stay with the agent. Display order is array order. A malformed or repeated-id item is dropped, the profile survives; an empty list is omitted.
